test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six students, P, Q, R, S, T and U have been instructed to keep their books on six different shelves of a bookshelf having only six shelves one over the other. Books of S are kept on the topmost shelf. Books of P and U are kept on third shelves from the extreme top and extreme bottom, respectively. Only books of R are kept between the shelves containing books of U and Q. Books of student T are kept on which shelf from the extreme top?
solution:
Six students, P, Q, R, S, T and U have been instructed to keep their books on six different shelves of a bookshelf having only six shelves one over the other.

1) Books of S are kept on the topmost shelf.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/558406a1ab3f9b106e91c69f99c9cdccd4512ee3664e8c8b7911764262a3ab88.png] 

2) Books of P and U are kept on third shelves from the extreme top and extreme bottom, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4013a3c34c289db22fc19cf3aa3022f100b58e15129d703740ccfa626cb129c.png] 

3) Only books of R are kept between the shelves containing books of U and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0045bdbfc2638e0bef14c021258a8ee45c7ed0bb20312c77a24dc0dc197e2842.png] 

∴ Here, the books of student 'T' is kept on 2ⁿd shelve from extreme top.

Hence, the correct answer is **"2ⁿd**".
